summary: A monophonic macro-oscillator synth running the unchanged Plaits DSP code, with the module's CV inputs replaced by a modulation matrix and its knobs by the FM-1's encoders.
features: 24 Plaits models in 3 banks, from virtual analog to speech and drums
Low-pass gate with decay and colour; OUT/AUX mix and stereo spread
ADSR, two LFOs and an 8-slot modulation matrix
GATE, TRIG and DRONE play modes, hold, glide and legato
16 presets in flash; USB and TRS MIDI in
